questions.question_bn: Springs k₁=8, k₂=16 N/m series-এ mass m। effective k কত?

questions.question_bn: Planet radius R, surface g=11 m/s²। height R-এ gravitational acceleration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Distance from centre r=2R। g(r)=g₀(R/r)²=g₀/4=(11)/4; height centre-distance নয়।

questions.question_bn: Mass defect 11/1000u, 1u c²=931.5MeV। binding energy কত MeV?

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=13D make 120°। net dipole কত D?

questions.question_bn: Cell E=0.50 V,nₑ=2,extent 13 mol reaction। F96500C/mol। ΔG কত kJ?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। ΔG=−extent·(13)ₑFE=−(13)·2·96500·0.5 J=−96.5nkJ। spontaneouspositive EnegativeG।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 19%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। Convertedmass 1000·(19)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic alkane C12H26 complete combustion-এ 1 mol fuel-এর O₂ requirement কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। CₙH₂ₙ₊₂→nCO₂+((12)+1)H₂O। oxygen atoms 3×(12)+1⇒O₂=(3×(12)+1)/2 mol; water oxygen ও ধরতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: HaberprocessN₂input 4 mol,H₂excess,singlepassN₂conversion 25%। NH₃out কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। ReactedN₂=(4)/4 mol。 N₂→2NH₃mole factor 2⇒NH₃(4)/2 mol; unreactedN₂recyclingwouldadditionalpasses।

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=256×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((16)²×10⁻⁹)=(16)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: CO poisoning-এ প্রধান binding target কী?
questions.explanation: CO haemoglobin-এর সঙ্গে strong binding করে oxygen transport কমায়; কম concentration-এও serious exposure risk থাকে।

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=9 mol,H₂=18 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(9))/3,availableN₂(9) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(9)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।

questions.question_bn: 17molnon-electrolyte 500gwater-এ dissolve। molality কত mol/kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Molality=moles/solventmasskg=(17)/0.5=2×(17)। solution volume বা solution mass denominator নয়।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 15×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (15)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((15)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: Sample 12 mol diene (2C=C per molecule), complete Br₂ addition। Br₂ mole required কত?

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 19mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 84mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 21mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: Bleach sample 25 mol OCl⁻ acidic iodometry-তে I₂ কত mol মুক্ত করে? OCl⁻+2I⁻+2H⁺→I₂+Cl⁻+H₂O
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Balanced reaction অনুযায়ী OCl⁻:I₂=1:1। iodide coefficient 2 হলেও iodine molecules (25) mol; redox electron balance 2।

questions.question_bn: Acidic 2H⁺+2e⁻→H₂। charge 5F,efficiency 100%। hydrogen mole কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। TwoelectrononeH₂; n Faradaymeansnmoleelectrons⇒H₂(5)/2 mol。 atom Hcountmoleculecount ভুলনয়।

questions.question_bn: 17 mol primary alcohol RCH₂OH fully oxidise toRCOOH। total electron loss কত mol?

questions.question_bn: Atomic number 28, charge 3+। electron count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Neutral electron=Z। cation 3+ means তিন electron lost: Ne=Z−3=(18)+7; proton unchanged।

questions.question_bn: (NH₄)₂SO₄ sample 660g। Nmass কত g? N14,H1,S32,O16

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=21×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 21। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((21)×10⁻²)=(1/(21))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=10M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(10)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((10)−1), initial concentration নয়।

questions.question_bn: এক fat molecule-এ 6 C=C bond।1 mol fat fully hydrogenate করতে H₂ কত mol?

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=5, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 50g,dry mass 40g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 80 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।
